TriScottsdale Saturday Group Ride

Scottsdale, AZ · Road

TriScottsdale Saturday Group Ride is a road group ride in Scottsdale, AZ. It rolls every Saturday at 6:30 am from Village Tavern.

For visitors

The club's page says 'or just show up'; its waiver is on the club's site. The start time changes with the season, so check the Saturday calendar the week you come. The calendar names the route for each Saturday (Towers, Los Gatos - Toms Thumb, 9 mile, or a 'special'). Early starts: bring lights in the darker months.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 19 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the TriScottsdale Saturday Group Ride group ride

TriScottsdale's Saturday road ride from the Village Tavern on Scottsdale Road. It splits into two groups: A averages 19 mph, B 15 to 17. The club's calendar posts the route and the start time for each week. Rides run about 50 to 60 miles.
